owner_and_capability: Fifth slice of #4077: the operator dashboard projection of Organization Tenancy and the staff-announcement audience projection of Communication answer in their own row types inside the owners' trees; the owners' compositions map the rows onto their domain types, so neither projection imports its owner's internal domain.

atomic_cutover: Code cutover without a new rule or policy epoch. operatordashboard declares Counts, OrganizationSummary, SchoolSummary and PWAUsageRow, audience declares Announcement, Target, ViewDetail and Stats; each projection package has a Rows mapping struct and Map wrapper (mapped.go) that implements the owner's port from mapping functions the owner's compose package passes in. Communication's viewerNames adapter moves to api/communication_viewer_names.go and Organization Tenancy's school lookup to api/school_lookup.go, offsetting the compose lines; the Communication compose test moves to api/communication_announcements_composition_test.go. Four stale rules are deleted. Each projection has result and foreign-tenant tests (mapped_test.go, projection_test.go).
tests: Operator dashboard mapped and projection tests, staff audience projection tests, Organization Tenancy and Communication suites and the root composition test through test-changed.
